purpose: Order 115 hypothesis-1 A/B: prioritize exact deterministic path discovery when an instruction describes an unspecified local artifact stored in a named user directory.
change_scope: Preserve every v115 action and runtime behavior. When an instruction names a local file type but not an exact path and says the artifact was stored, supplied, provided, downloaded, or placed in a user directory, boost the existing read-only filesystem.find facade into the initial top-k surface. Explicit absolute or ~/ paths do not trigger the boost. No action or argument is forced after model generation.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this hypothesis-1 A/B, classify the new failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. At most two further materially different generic hypotheses remain before marking Order 115 task_blocked and advancing.

implementation_evidence.parent_baseline_diagnosis: The model opened the Desktop, copied a visually truncated long XCF filename as a literal path containing ellipsis, repeated the same nonexistent path through desktop and GIMP calls, and stopped under the eight-event no-progress guard after nine steps. The existing filesystem.find action was not in the initial top-seven surface.
implementation_evidence.candidate_bundle_hash_method: SHA-256 of the sha256sum line for the single modified production module.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 583 catalog, strict-schema, and Runtime tests passed; Ruff passed on the changed production and test modules.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: Different .kra and .svg artifact instructions in Downloads and Desktop prioritize filesystem.find. An unrelated instruction containing an explicit absolute image path does not trigger the discovery boost. No task ID, source basename, requested output basename, golden data, or evaluator value is present in code or tests.

selection.method: first targeted generic A/B for Order 115 in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger
